towerpro.publisher: Tower Pro original-manufacturer MG90S listing; not proof of ROB-009 identity

SunFounder_SF3218MG.voltage_mapping_caveat: The official listing gives torque and speed ranges without assigning each endpoint to a particular voltage. Do not interpolate a supposedly verified 6 V torque/speed from these ranges.

BC_Robotics_ROB009_MG90S.speed_caveat: Seller lists speed without a load condition or a torque-speed curve; the advertised speed is not simultaneous with stall torque.

TowerPro_original_MG90S_reference_only.conflict: The original-maker page prints operating voltage 4.8 V and lists the 2.2 kgf.cm torque at 6.6 V, whereas ROB-009 seller lists it at 6.0 V. Preserve the seller-specific rating and do not silently merge the data or recommend 6.6 V for ROB-009.

assumed_simulation_conditions.meaning: A chosen supply scenario within both direct product listing voltage ranges; loaded voltage/current is not simulated or verified.

assumed_simulation_conditions.torque_speed_envelope: No calibrated envelope available. Constant caps above are test assumptions. Do not claim they represent real servo torque at speed. Use slow commands and report actual peak speed and torque separately.
assumed_simulation_conditions.damping_status: Chosen numerical viscous damping only, not measured bearing, servo or tendon friction; sweep 0.5x and 2x and do not count this as identified hardware.

main_PD_initial_tuning.status: Optional starting gains for a simulated controller only. Clip the TOTAL feedback plus any gravity feedforward torque to the selected cap; gains are not real servo electronics.

assumed_simulation_conditions.no_hidden_assistance: During physical grasp trials, never use qpos overwrites, kinematic mocap/welded objects, unlimited gravity compensation, or hand-set object forces to keep the object attached.

mass_assumptions.scale_meaning: Mass-only sensitivity of PETG parts relative to a homogeneous solid CAD model; not slicer infill percentage, measured weight, or a rigorous upper bound on the assembled arm. Scaled COM remains unchanged. TPU pads, PTFE, motors and purchased hardware masses stay fixed.
mass_assumptions.micro_mass_caveat: Original TowerPro reference scenario, not verified ROB-009 mass.
mass_assumptions.unmodeled_mass: Actual spring wire, tendon, adhesive, wiring and unmodeled fastening/strain-relief masses remain unknown; no fabricated point reserve is added.

static_torque_method.calculation: Sum m*g*J_com_z for every correctly articulated component plus 0.1*g*J_object_z. This is actuator-equivalent generalized holding torque opposing gravity. No acceleration, friction, joint spring torque or object contact coupling is added.
static_torque_method.finger_motion: Each component COM follows its resolved proximal/distal/palm body. Finger changes therefore alter main-axis COM demands.
static_torque_method.legacy_crosscheck: At open fingers, compared all 3 mass scales and all 5 main postures to work/v6/dynamics.py MG(q, payload=.1), with nonphysical spring envelopes excluded in both.
static_torque_method.reachability: The horizontal and downward-palm samples exceed the preview travel windows. They are load-demand comparisons only; no feasibility or collision-free trajectory is asserted.
static_torque_method.sufficiency: Torque below an assumed cap is necessary for that assumed static case, not sufficient for real motion, motor thermal safety, or grasp stability.

friction_only_vertical_hold_necessary_co.equation: sum(mu_i*N_i) >= m*(g+a_up); additionally enforce contact normal directions and moment balance. This scalar inequality alone does not prove force closure or prevent rolling.
friction_only_vertical_hold_necessary_co.mu_status: Deliberate dry-contact sensitivity assumptions, not material coefficients measured for the actual pads or cups.

recommended_grasp_trial_acceptance.status: Explicit test targets, not standards or proof of hardware safety.
recommended_grasp_trial_acceptance.object: 100 g free rigid body, no weld/kinematic attachment; specify shape, dimensions and mass properties for each test.
recommended_grasp_trial_acceptance.no_drop: Object remains at least 45 mm above its initial COM height throughout the hold and is supported by gripper contacts, not the table or a hidden constraint.
recommended_grasp_trial_acceptance.contact_check: Track per-finger contact counts and contact forces. For a three-finger wrap test require contacts with all three distinct finger groups during the hold; separate this from more permissive two-finger tests.
recommended_grasp_trial_acceptance.actuator_check: Report peak/RMS torque, max speed, saturation duration/fraction and holding position error. Compare to chosen scenario caps only. Motor continuous ratings remain unverified even if a 3-second simulated hold passes.
recommended_grasp_trial_acceptance.headroom_status: Chosen evaluation margin, not a validated derating rule.
recommended_grasp_trial_acceptance.penetration_status: Chosen numerical screening threshold; tighten for thin cup walls and audit collision proxies.
recommended_grasp_trial_acceptance.numerical_robustness: Repeat with timestep halved; confirm pass/fail unchanged and report change in slip/penetration and torque. Repeat friction, torque caps, mass scale, spring/preload and damping sensitivities instead of reporting one tuned successful run.
recommended_grasp_trial_acceptance.object_damage: Rigid-body MuJoCo contact does not establish paper/plastic cup crushing, print strength, layer failure, horn slip, spring fatigue or screw capacity.
